title: One-Word Sketch · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play One-Word Sketch · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner writes one familiar object on a hidden slip and gives it to the lead. The lead draws the object without letters, numbers or speech. The other players identify the object. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In One-Word Sketch, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The other players identify the object.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The other players identify the object.
